Lemma
[Locality on open sets]

Source: petersen:page-0073, petersen:page-0074 ↗ def:pet-ch2-affine-connection

1. ch2:2.2.3Let $ abla $ be an affine connection on $M$, $p\in M$, $v\in T_pM$, and $X,Y$ vector fields with $X=Y$ on a neighborhood $U i p$. Then $ abla _vX= abla _vY$.
Proof

↗ lem:pet-ch2-locality-open-set

\sketch Choose a smooth $\lambda $ supported in $U$ and equal to $1$ near $p$. Then $\lambda X=\lambda Y$ globally, while $\lambda (p)=1$ and $d\lambda _p=0$ imply $ abla _v(\lambda X)= abla _vX$ and $ abla _v(\lambda Y)= abla _vY$.

□
